description: Children are the future -- and so are their inventions, which is why "Think Big" could be an important show. It features young inventors competing to see who can come up with the most-innovative invention. Each episode features two teams in the Think Tank -- a studio filled with art supplies and construction materials -- who brainstorm and choose materials before sketching, designing and building a prototype to be presented to a judge, who determines a winner. The champions earn bragging rights

description: Teaching financial education and entrepreneurship to a preteen audience; sketch comedy and young actors help explain basic economic concepts.

description: Profiles of the top rookie, college and high-school talent in sports; athletes share their experiences, advice and personal impressions of the road to stardom.

title: America's Heartland
description: Much of the food Americans eat is produced by farmers and ranchers in the country's heartland, but many people don't know how it's produced. "America's Heartland" provides information about the people and processes responsible for the availability of food and fuel across the country and around the world. title: Beyond the Purple Hills
description: When a bank robbery results in the death of the sheriff, Judge Beaumont (Roy Gordon) asks horse trainer Gene Autry (Gene Autry) to take the sheriff's place. Gene, who has helped Beaumont deal with his fractious son, Jack (Hugh O'Brian), agrees. Beaumont then reveals that he wants to rewrite his will to leave Jack out, prompting a fight between father and son. When the judge is murdered soon after, Gene is forced to arrest Jack, despite not believing that he is guilty.

title: See Wrinkles and Bags Vanish Instantly With GEN90!!
description: GEN90 Instant Wrinkle Treatment with Retinol will turn back the clock! The Pharmacist's solution for wrinkles, instant and long-term! Visibly reduces the appearance of crow's feet and fine lines instantly! Get fast, visible, long-lasting results!

title: The Lone Ranger
description: A bandit terrorizes a woman who witnessed a robbery.

title: The Lone Ranger

title: Power From on High With Darrel Sutton
description: A program designed to ignite a fire in you for evangelism and missions.

title: Forgotten Truths
description: Presenting the Word of God rightly divided so that the lost may hear the Gospel of the Grace of God, and Believers can learn how to understand and enjoy the Bible.

description: Better Bladder is a new safe and natural alternative to drugs, surgery and adult diapers. 90 percent see fewer bathroom visits, leaks & accidents. Tune in for a special TV offer!

description: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

title: The Beverly Hillbillies
description: Jethro shares a heart-to-heart conversation with Jed, and goes on to find himself a girlfriend in record time.

title: Bonanza
description: For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.

title: Bonanza
description: An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.

title: Tomorrow's World
description: For more than 20 years, Tomorrow's World has been sharing the good news of Jesus Christ's coming Kingdom and blowing a bold warning trumpet of God's impending judgment, calling for repentance and spiritual change.

title: Manna-Fest With Perry Stone
description: In-depth study of the word of God.

title: Transformed by Grace
description: Transformed by Grace is the daily television program produced by The Berean Bible Society. Join Pastor Kevin Sadler as he shares the transforming power of God's grace in your daily life.

title: Jentezen Franklin: The Power of Short Prayers
description: What if the most important prayers weren't the longest?; helping believers discover how brief, heartfelt prayers can bring breakthrough, peace and divine intervention.

description: Dr. Gabriel Rogers is the founder and pastor of Kingdom Christian Church, a Spirit-filled church located in Charlotte, North Carolina.

title: Catholic Mass
description: Experience the inspiration of the Catholic Sunday Mass brought to you by Heart of the Nation.

title: The Pastor's Study
description: Biblical preaching to bring unbelievers to saving faith in Jesus Christ and to strengthen the faith of those who are already believers.

title: The Big Show
description: Arrogant film star Tom Ford (Gene Autry) goes AWOL before a high-profile personal appearance at the Texas Centennial Exposition in Dallas. In a panic, publicist Lee Wilson (William Newell) instructs Ford's screen double, kindhearted cowboy Gene Autry (also Autry), to go on in Ford's place. Gangster Rico (Harry Worth), to whom Ford owes $10,000, and Ford's fiancée, Toodles (Sally Payne), complicate the deception, as does Gene's budding romance with lady rancher Marion (Kay Hughes).

title: The Blazing Sun
description: Bank robbers Bartlett (Kenne Duncan) and Lucas (Gregg Barton) escape and hide out in the hills between the towns of White Water and Los Robles. In White Water, bank investigator Gene Autry (Gene Autry) grows suspicious of the activities of mine technician Ben Luber (Alan Hale Jr.) and his brother. When he discovers that the brothers are secretly providing aid to the robbers, Gene enlists his friend Mike (Pat Buttram) and a nurse, Helen (Lynne Roberts), to help him track down the criminals.

title: The Aging Brain
description: Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.

title: The Ernest Angley Hour
description: Rev. Angley presents the fullness of God's word to viewers.

title: End-Time Insights
description: Steven & Elizabeth Cochran deliver new, never before seen, Biblical end-time revelations; buckle up.

title: Larry and Tiz Huch
description: Pastors Larry and Tiz Huch teach about the blessings and miracles found in rediscovering the Judeo-Christian roots of our faith and the biblical importance of standing with the nation of Israel.
